title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B = 1 T from force balance F = mg + B²l²v₀/R during constant velocity motion.

title: Total time to highest point
description: Essential: Correctly computes total time t = l/v₀ + v₀/g = 0.3 s, combining entry and post-entry ascent.

title: Landing velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly determines landing velocity v = 4 m/s using energy or kinematics, accounting for magnetic damping.

title: Total Joule heat
description: Essential: Correctly calculates Q = 2mgl = 0.4 J from energy conservation over complete cycle.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law during constant velocity phase with F = mg + F_amp.

title: Entry kinematics
description: Important: Recognizes uniform motion during entry phase with t₁ = l/v₀.

title: Post-entry ascent kinematics
description: Important: Analyzes free-fall-like ascent after force removal with t₂ = v₀/g.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Uses energy conservation to relate mechanical work/energy to Joule heat.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign conventions for forces, velocities, or induced EMF directions.

title: Magnetic force omission
description: Pitfall: Neglects magnetic damping force during exit/landing phase, leading to incorrect velocity.
